operations.description: Removes the specified admin as a manager of the specified location.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] mybusinessaccountmanagement locations admins delete [PATH]  [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Lists all of the accounts for the authenticated user. This includes all accounts that the user owns, as well as any accounts for which the user has management rights.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] mybusinessaccountmanagement accounts list [PATH] accounts [PARAMS] access account alt callback fields filter key oauth page parent pretty print protocol quota size token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] account accounts info list organization response

operations.description: Gets the specified account. Returns `NOT_FOUND` if the account does not exist or if the caller does not have access rights to it.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] mybusinessaccountmanagement accounts [PATH]  [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] account address info organization postal

operations.description: Lists all of the admins for the specified location.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] mybusinessaccountmanagement locations admins list [PATH] admins [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] admin admins list location response

operations.description: Lists pending invitations for the specified account.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] mybusinessaccountmanagement accounts invitations list [PATH] invitations [PARAMS] access alt callback fields filter key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] account invitation invitations list location response target

operations.description: Updates the Admin for the specified location. Only the AdminRole of the Admin can be updated.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] mybusinessaccountmanagement locations admins patch [PATH]  [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key mask name oauth only pretty print protocol quota token type update upload user validate xgafv [SCHEMA] admin

operations.description: Creates an account with the specified name and type under the given parent. - Personal accounts and Organizations cannot be created. - User Groups cannot be created with a Personal account as primary owner. - Location Groups cannot be created with a primary owner of a Personal account if the Personal account is in an Organization. - Location Groups cannot own Location Groups.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] mybusinessaccountmanagement accounts create [PATH] accounts [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] account address info organization postal

[METHOD] post [NAME] mybusinessaccountmanagement accounts invitations accept [PATH] name accept [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] accept invitation request

[METHOD] post [NAME] mybusinessaccountmanagement accounts invitations decline [PATH] name decline [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] decline invitation request

operations.description: Moves a location from an account that the user owns to another account that the same user administers. The user must be an owner of the account the location is currently associated with and must also be at least a manager of the destination account.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] mybusinessaccountmanagement locations transfer [PATH] name transfer [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] location request transfer

operations.description: Invites the specified user to become an administrator for the specified location. The invitee must accept the invitation in order to be granted access to the location. See AcceptInvitation to programmatically accept an invitation.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] mybusinessaccountmanagement locations admins create [PATH] admins [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] admin
